meta.name: notify-user
meta.description: Send email notifications to users via Mailgun API. Use when scheduled jobs complete, encounter errors, need user input, or have important updates to report. Requires Mailgun credentials configured via credential-activation skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发送邮件通知,让用户及时知晓任务状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要给用户自动发送邮件提醒
copy.tagline_en: Send email notifications so users stay informed
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automatically email users about important events

howto.what: 当有重要事件时,Claude会通过Mailgun发邮件通知你。邮件可套用任务完成、失败、进度更新等模板,支持纯文本、HTML和多人抄送,并在发送后检查结果。
howto.when: 在计划任务完成、遇到错误或需要用户输入等情况下触发。

say.text: 计划任务完成后,发邮件把结果告诉我。
say.note: 生成任务完成邮件并发送。

say.text: 如果任务出错,发邮件提醒我处理。
say.note: 邮件包含错误详情和建议操作。

say.text: 需要我提供信息时,用邮件问我。
say.note: 以邮件方式把问题发到你的邮箱。

howto.what_en: Claude sends email notifications via Mailgun when important events occur. It uses templates for job success, failure, progress updates, etc., supports plain text, HTML, and multiple recipients, and checks the send result.
howto.when_en: Triggered when scheduled jobs complete, errors occur, or user input is needed, among other important updates.

say_en.text: Email me the result after the scheduled job finishes.
say_en.note: Generates and sends a completion email.

say_en.text: If the job fails, email me to handle it.
say_en.note: Email includes error details and suggested actions.

say_en.text: Email me if you need information from me.
say_en.note: Sends the question to your inbox.
